paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan lui khen suahlam a om Amorte kumpipa tengteng leh tuipi gei a om Kanaan gam kumpipa tengtengte'n, agalkah masiah uh TOUPA'N Jordan tuite Israel suante ma ah akangtatsak, chih ana zak un, Israel suante ziak in alungtang uh ana zul khin a, lauthawng lou himhim a-om kei uhi.
heading: Gilgal A Zeksumna
english: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Temta hiam kibawl inla, Israel suante zek anihveina ding in sumsak in," achi hi.
english: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”

paite: Joshua in temta hiamte akibawl a, Israel suante Gibeth Haraloth ah azek uh asumsak hi.
english: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

paite: Joshua in azeksumna ziak hiai ahi: Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng, pasal galdoumi tengteng Aigupta gam a pan apawtkhiak nung un lamkal a gamdai a asih khit tak ziak uh ahi.
english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng zeksumsa vek ahi ua; himahleh Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua gamdai a lamkal a piang tengteng bel zeksum ahi kei uhi.
english: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

paite: TOUPA aw angaihkhiak nop louh ziak ua mipi tengteng, Aigupta gam a pan hong pawt galdou mite tan hihman a a-om vek tan un Israel suante gamdai ah kum sawmli avialvak uhi. TOUPA'N amau pi-le-pute kiang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam kichiam a piak ana chiam, huai gam mu lou ding in akiang uah TOUPA ana kichiamta hi.
english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice. Yahweh swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which Yahweh swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Asuante uh amau sik a akhanletsakte Joshua in azek uh asumsak hi. Lamkal a azek uh sum ahih louh ziak in zeksum louh ana hi him uhi.
english: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng zek asum khit un, adam mateng uh amau giahphual chiat uah a-om uhi.
english: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Tuni in Aiguptate'n nou hon muhsitna uh noumau a pan ka khukmangta," achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in huai mun Gilgal achi uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.

paite: Israel suante'n Gilgal ah giahphual asat ua; Jeriko Phaizang ah huai kha, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang alui uhi.
english: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

paite: Paikan khit azing mah in huai gam a tanghou silngou soh louh leh vaimim kan ane uhi.
english: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.

paite: Huai gam a buh anek ni zing ua pan manna aketa kei a; Israel suante'n manna leng amu nawn kei uhi. Huai kum in Kanaan gam a buh-le-bal ane zawta uhi.
english: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

paite: Huan Jeriko kho kiangchin a Joshua a-om lai in adak a, a-entou a, ngai in, hichi ahong hi a, amazawn chin ah mi khat anamsau phawisa tawi in ana ding hi. Joshua in ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kou lam a pang na hi hia, ka melmate uh lam a pang?" achi hi.
heading: Joshua Leh Namsau Tawi Pasal Khat
english: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”

paite: Ama'n, “Hilou e, TOUPA sepaihte heutu dia hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi. Huchi in lei ah Joshua abokkhup a, amah abia a, akiang ah, "Ka toupa'n asikha kiang ah bang gen ding nei ahia?" achi hi.
english: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped, and asked him, “What does my lord say to his servant?”

paite: TOUPA sepaihte heutu in Joshua kiang ah, "Na khepek a pan na khedap phel in. Na dinna mun siangthou ahi,” achi a; huchi in Joshua in aphelta hi.
english: The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.
